description: Source code for the WebExtensionServer class handling notes, notebooks, tags, and clip saving in the Notesnook project.

classes.name: WebExtensionServer
classes.description: Implements the Server interface for web extension interactions, including login, fetching notes/notebooks/tags, and saving clips.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Retrieves user login status and theme information.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes with specific fields.

methods.name: getNotebooks
methods.description: Fetches root or child notebooks based on parentId.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Fetches all tags with specific fields.

methods.name: saveClip
methods.description: Saves a clip, creating a new note with clip content, handling attachments, and updating relations.
